regex.json.about: Simple regex helper file used for the frontend display of information invoked by JavaScript formatter functions inside the web app's script file - ./script.js.

report.json.about: Portfolio health report and pre-merger security check file used to verify current system integrity and screening of additional entries before merger or quaranteen protocols for the Financial Modelling Shell's Portfolio - data/portfolio.json.

settings.json.about: settings file used for configuring the portfolio's price table and metrics.

CACHE.latest-newborn.json: Temporary output file created by main.py via incubator.pywhich holds data for a new entry waiting to be merged into portfolio.json.
CACHE.latest-reborn.json: Temporary output file created by incubator.py which holds targeted update data for an existing entry waiting to be updsted into portfolio.json.
CACHE.latest-refresh.json: Temporary output file created by incubator.py which holds batch data for all portfolio entries waiting to be merged into portfolio.json.

historic.json.about: Master historic market data for entries in the portfolio.

DEVELOPER.about: Directory for random developer and LLM agent files used during production.

AVANTAGE.about: Directory containing example files stored as fetched in raw format from Alpha Vantage.

YFINANCE.about: Directory containing example files stored as fetched in raw format from yFinance.

paginator.py.ABOUT: Menu paginator module written in python for internal use.

LIB.historic.py: Utility script called by main.py via incubator.py which is tasked with fetching historic market price dara, storing archive per ticker symbol, creating a master historic record for the current portfolio entries as well as calculating and providing specific key:value pairings for the portfolio's HISTORY branch node.
LIB.merger.py: Utility script called by main.py via incubator.py which is tasked with diagnosing, maintaining, updating and verifying the portfolio data and health.
LIB.reporter.py: Termux based news feed script currently used by development team.
LIB.structure.py: Utility script called by main.py for high level skeletal msnipulation, use with caution (WIP prototype for top level developer clearance - it is highly recommended to do a manual backup and to use in a side branch of the github repository).
LIB.verifier.py: Utility script called by incubator.py for new ticker symbol and company names search

incubator.py.ABOUT:
Main engine for fetching singular or batch data from yFinance. Has two main branches one of which splits into two sub-branch. Outputs three different files depending on the flag.

updata.sh.ABOUT: Manual portfolio update file executed via CLI for full portfolio update.

DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.index.html: Financial Modelling Shell Lite's html file for the web app hosted on github pages.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.main.py: Python based portfolio manager and task delegator. This is the entry point for portfolio maintenance and updates.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.script.js: JavaScript based file which is the brains and nervous system to the html skeleton that makes up the FMSLite web app.
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE.style.css: CSS based file which acts as the superficial skin that holds the skeletal and inner systems of the FMSLite web app that defines physical beauty of the final product.
